description:
Find the input value needed to achieve a target result (like Excel's Goal Seek).
Iteratively adjusts the control cell until the target cell reaches the desired value.

controlCell.description: Cell to adjust to achieve the target

targetCell.description: Cell containing the formula to reach target value

targetValue.description: Desired value for the target cell

persist.description: Whether to persist the solved control cell (and any pre-seek writes) to the workbook. Defaults to false: a pure calculation that reports the solution without changing the model.

write.description: Values to write before goal seeking

value.description: Value to write before running goal seek

name: goalSeek
